description: Upload a custom emoji from an image URL, or from a file in the local files folder when one is set, or several at once with emojis. Discord's limit for emoji files is 256 KB; png, jpeg, gif, and webp work, and a still png or jpeg over the limit is made smaller (128 pixels on its longer side). Several are all checked first (pictures, free slots) and nothing is uploaded unless all of them can be.

emojis.description: Several emoji to upload together, each with a name and an image_url or image_file, instead of name and one image.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

image_file.description: An image file in the local files folder (DISCORD_MCP_FILES_DIR), by name, instead of a link. Only that folder is read, and only when it is set.

image_url.description: Public http or https link to the image file itself.

name.description: The emoji's name: letters, digits and underscores. Needed for one upload with image_url or image_file; with emojis, each item has its own name.

name: create_emoji
title: Create emoji
